title: magnolia macrocarpa
intro: Magnolia macrocarpa, commonly known as the Northern Magnolia, is a deciduous tree species native to China. The Northern Magnolia is valued for its medicinal properties and is used to treat various health conditions, including fever, rheumatism, and coughs, due to its health benefits. Its therapeutic actions include anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and expectorant properties, making it effective in relieving respiratory issues and soothing skin irritations. The bioactive constituents of the Northern Magnolia include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
